name: quick-quote-link-search
description: Browser extension for viewing quote tweets and searching Twitter/X for webpage mentions

scripts.build:chrome: rm -rf dist/chrome && mkdir -p dist/chrome/common && cp -r src/chrome/* dist/chrome/ && cp -r src/common/* dist/chrome/common/ && sed -i 's|"../common/|"common/|g' dist/chrome/manifest.json && sed -i "s|'../common/|'common/|g" dist/chrome/background.js
scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist/firefox && mkdir -p dist/firefox/common && cp -r src/firefox/* dist/firefox/ && cp -r src/common/* dist/firefox/common/ && sed -i 's|"../common/|"common/|g' dist/firefox/manifest.json
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist/chrome && zip -r ../chrome-extension.zip * && cd ../firefox && zip -r ../firefox-extension.zip *
